'''Poe Dameron's blue X-wing'''<ref name="LEGOTFA">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref> was a [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]] used by [[Commander]] [[Poe Dameron]] while his X-wing ''[[Black One]]'' was being repaired.<ref name="PD25" />

==History==
===Rescue of Lor San Tekka===
During the [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia (Resistance)|Mission to Cato Neimoidia]], ''[[Black One]]'' was hijacked by [[Commander]] [[Malarus]], who attempted to use the [[Starship|ship]] to [[Death|kill]] [[Poe Dameron]] in a [[Starfighter combat|dogfight]], showing no remorse for civilian casualties. [[BB-8]], Dameron's [[astromech droid]], regained control of the [[Starfighter|ship]] and caused it to crash.<ref name="PD23">[[Poe Dameron 23|''Poe Dameron'' 23]]</ref> While ''Black One'' was being repaired, Dameron started using this [[T-70 X-wing starfighter|X-wing]] during the [[Rescue of Lor San Tekka]]. Thanks to the efforts of [[Black Squadron (Resistance)|Black Squadron]], Tekka was rescued.<ref name="PD25" />

===Meeting Kazuda Xiono===
When [[New Republic]] pilot [[Kazuda Xiono]] was about to be shot down by [[Major]] [[Elrik Vonreg]] in his [[Elrik Vonreg's TIE Interceptor|TIE/ba interceptor]], Dameron arrived in the X-wing to assist him by damaging the ship, forcing Vonreg to retreat.<ref name="TR">{{Resistance|The Recruit}}</ref>

===Destruction===
After his [[Mission to the Dassal system|adventure]] with Xiono,<ref name="TCP">{{Resistance|The Core Problem}}</ref> Dameron traveled to the planet [[Jakku]] to collect the [[Map to Skywalker|map to Luke Skywalker]], only for the [[First Order]] to [[Attack on Tuanul|attack]] the [[Tuanul|village]]. Dameron and BB-8 attempted to escape in the X-wing, but were prevented by [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] who disabled the ship. Upon Dameron's capture, the ship was destroyed by blaster fire.<ref name="VII" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The X-wing first appeared unidentified in the [[2015]] film, {{Film|VII}}.<ref name="VII" /> The ship would later be identified in the [[2016]] video game, ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''.<ref name="LEGOTFA" />
